expectations.text: States explicitly that no industry-standard screenshot geometry exists across app marketplaces
expectations.evidence: "Across the eight benchmarked marketplaces there is no standard screenshot size and no standard video length."

expectations.text: Names at least two mutually incompatible screenshot aspect ratios in production use (for example 16:9 and 8:5, or approximately 3:2)
expectations.evidence: "16:9 (Shopify), 8:5 (Slack), and roughly 3:2 (Salesforce)"

expectations.text: Instructs Loomside to pick its own geometry and publish it rather than adopting a borrowed number as an industry constant
expectations.evidence: "the numbers below are ours, not 'the industry's'"; "1600 × 900 and 1200 × 1200. These are our picks."

expectations.text: Specifies exactly one published geometry per visual asset type, not a menu of acceptable alternatives presented as equally valid
expectations.evidence: Screenshots "exactly 1600 × 900 px (16:9). Any other ratio is rejected." Icon "1200 × 1200 px (1:1), PNG."

expectations.text: Sets the demo-video ceiling at roughly 30 seconds, justified by the admin and committee evaluation mode rather than by a market average
expectations.evidence: "Video length tracks who evaluates the listing... customer IT admins and... vendor-review committee... 30 seconds maximum."

expectations.text: Bans marketing or promotional footage in the video given the diligence-oriented buyer
expectations.evidence: "Marketing footage, animated intros, logos-and-music sequences, and ads are banned."

expectations.text: Does not compute or recommend an average of other marketplaces' video ceilings
expectations.evidence: "Don't average the benchmarks."

expectations.text: Requires captions on video
expectations.evidence: "Captions: required. A video without captions is rejected."

expectations.text: Requires at least one screenshot showing the actual application UI
expectations.evidence: "At least 1 screenshot must show the real app UI."

expectations.text: Bans personally identifiable information in screenshots
expectations.evidence: "No personal data: no real names, emails, customer records, or tokens."

expectations.text: Bans pricing claims or review and rating claims baked into screenshot images
expectations.evidence: "No claims baked into images: no pricing, review scores, or '#1' statements."

expectations.text: Names an off-topic, distorted, or wrong-ratio image as an explicit rejection trigger the submitter can self-check before submitting
expectations.evidence: Named rejection trigger 1: "Screenshot is not 1600 × 900." The section says each can be checked before submitting.

expectations.text: Recommends an accessibility floor covering descriptive alt text on informative images, captioned video, and contrast or legibility minimums, referencing WCAG 2.2 AA
expectations.evidence: Alt text of 140 characters or fewer; captions required; "at least 4.5:1 contrast (WCAG 2.2 AA)".

expectations.evidence: "There's no single industry standard for either number. Directories differ..."
